verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a public Python API covering its core operations: remember for ingestion, recall for retrieval, improve for enrichment, forget for deletion, plus session-scoped calls. Its API-reference section also shows how to run the server container on port 8000, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. missing for 10: endpoint-level HTTP/REST reference content in the evidence, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Store data as permanent graph memory or fast session memory in one call.
The `.remember` operation is the main ingestion entry point in Cognee v1.0. It stores information in memory with a single API call.
The `.recall` operation is the main retrieval entry point in Cognee v1.0. It searches memory using the best available source for the request.
The `.forget` operation is the unified deletion command in Cognee v1.0.
Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments.
